text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mmm-yesss! It was even better than I imagined!
"Sapporo Ramen Alley"!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Even though it's all called 'Sapporo Miso Ramen,' every shop has its own unique flavor!
Ahhh... If only my stomach were an endless universe!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our ramen training journey has reached its fifth stop.
We find ourselves visiting Sapporo, Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now, where shall we go next?
This time, instead of tourist spots, I'd like to experience the local culture!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-In that case... just like back in Nagoya, maybe a p-part-time job...? How does that sound...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A part-time job! Yeah, yeah!
That's a great idea! In that case—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Thank you so much
for letting me visit earlier!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In that case—could you please let me
live and work here?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
L-L-Live-in work?!
Wait, on a ranch?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because I want to know! How everyone
in Hokkaido lives their daily lives!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Daily life intertwined with the vastness of nature...
Would you allow me to experience that for myself?

text_block_list.name: Ranch Owner
text_block_list.text:
...Well ain't you super motivated!
No worries, no worries, we'll count on ya startin' tomorrow!
It's an early morning, so be ready, alright?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wah, thank you very much!
I'll do my very best!"
choice_data_list: I'll contact the academy about it.
I'll get in touch with the academy about that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll probably take a short break.
I just hope it turns out to be a fruitful experience—

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text:
......You want to experience our lifestyle?
We're not playing games here, you know...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho...

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Employee
text_block_list.text: How's it going? The mucking out. Isn't it a bit too heavy a load for you~?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's a job I'm not really used to,
so it feels unfamiliar, but—fufu♪
It's very rewarding and a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. You should head out for your lunch break soon.
Whatever work you couldn't finish, we'll—

text_block_list.name: Bob-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. The cattle shed is all clean.
Every single corner, too...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because I wanted to see this through to the end!
Well then, I'll take a break now.

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. That's my station.
You don't need to go that far gathering the bait.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry! If I was going to do that,
I should've asked if it was okay first.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Instead, is there any work left to do?
I'll do whatever I can to help!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm being given such a priceless experience!
I have to answer that with my actions!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text:
This area tends to have clear skies in the winter.
That's why the snow hasn't piled up.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh, is that right! I was wondering how it worked when it's this cold, but—

text_block_list.name: All the Employees
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Fine!" "Good morning!"
"Morning~! Looking forward to working with you today!"
"You've really settled into this early-morning routine, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Good day to you all♪
Let's do our best today as well!

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text: "Oh, that's right. We're all heading out for some local ramen for lunch today. Fine, you guys should come along too."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Brrr, so cold! Even with the sun out,
February in Hokkaido makes your hands go completely numb...

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text:
Heh, too tough for a mainlander?
We're almost at our destination. Hang in there.

text_block_list.name: Fine & Right O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~! So good~~~!
Delicious! Another bowl!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"With every slurp of the noodles,
I get warmer from the inside out... It's the best!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: It was so delicious the temperature contrast almost made me faint. Wouldn't this taste even better eaten outside? All right.
choice_data_list: Stop. You can't take the bowl outside, okay?

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Did you guys
like it that much?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yup♪ Corn and butter are great, but miso ramen packed with veggies is awesome too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The rich flavor is part of the charm too... Huh?
Could it be that using extra lard
is to keep the soup from cooling down!?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Bullseye, young lady!
That's right, that's another clever trick unique to the north.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ I totally understand why ramen
is so deeply loved in this area now.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Once you eat it, you overflow with vitality and warm up
from the inside out... Ramen tastes especially delicious
precisely when you're in a freezing cold place!
choice_data_list: Any luck figuring out the ramen you want to make?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ...Is what I'd like to say,
but hmm, maybe not quite yet.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The reason why Hokkaido's ramen is so delicious...
Yup, I got to experience it firsthand!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: “However, merely imitating that won't make it a 'cup of gratitude'.”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's something we've learned together
—every time we visited different places.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So that's why we need to go one step further! I want to come up with a ramen that reaches the fans in Hokkaido, but...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I don't know if it'll be of any help, but race fans visit my place all the time.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
She used to laugh and say that after burning all her energy
cheering, she'd crave the ramen here no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. So the racing fans really love the ramen here.
I'm glad the place I recommended is getting such high praise.
choice_data_list: You only just learned about it today, and you're already acting like an old-timer, huh...
You only just learned about it today, and you're already acting like a veteran, huh...

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, when I went to watch a race with someone I met here before, they treated me to a beef bowl.
Apparently it was their favorite... It really was delicious, though.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Since you interact with them, you all
know a lot about race fans, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that obvious? The people of Hokkaido
know Hokkaido best, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that's true... Ah!?
Oh, I see! You're right!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The people living here in this region must understand
Hokkaido's race fans best of all! If so—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Say. Would you care to make ramen with me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Thank you so much
for gathering here today!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And now, we will begin our 'Study Group' to brainstorm ramen for the race fans!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All right. Say it with me, okay? Here we go!
Ei, ei—

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: "Ramen!!!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: T-There are so many people... One, two, three, four...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"There are easily 100 people here. Maybe 200.
Either way, a crazy huge crowd showed up."
choice_data_list: W-Why did it turn out like this...!?

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text: You're surprised, right...? Me too. Sure, she was calling out to all sorts of people, but still—

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Fisherman
text_block_list.text:
"Fine-san's 'Ramen Research Club'? Ah,
sounds great! I'll ask my friends too. When is it?"

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Farmer
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! If it's about that, count me in too!
I'll bring mountains of freshly picked veggies!

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Burger Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"I heard! Fine-chan's making ramen
with everyone in Hokkaido, right?
I'm joining in too! Even though I'm a burger joint!"

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text: "Everyone who talked to Fine, even for a bit, agreed with a big smile—"

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text:
"'If it means I can be of help to Fine Motion.'
—For just that simple reason alone."

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text: ...She's incredible. The ramen shop owner, the noodle factory boss... everyone who's gotten to know Fine's wonderful personality has gathered right here.
choice_data_list: Is this also a testament to her virtue...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with over 100 people gathered,
the Ramen Study Group went off without a hitch—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Welcoooome! Dig in, dig in!
Taste our pride and joy—'Dohmin Ramen'!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so good!? What is this!!
It's shoyu ramen, but it packs such a punch!

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text: A chicken and seafood base, huh...? The seafood broth really stands out. You're using some high-grade ingredients, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ You certainly have a refined palate!
That's right! I made the broth with kinki fish!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
W-With thornyhead!? Isn't thornyhead a high-end fish?
I thought it was pretty hard to get hold of.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The owner of the fish market
kindly provided it for the sake of this ramen.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's not just the kinki fish! The noodles, the water,
the soy sauce, the veggies—absolutely everything!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
They were provided by the people of Hokkaido.
That's exactly why it turned out so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm truly amazed. By each and every single thing
that everyone contributed for me."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Because the corn is as sweet as fruit! And the carrots smell exceptionally fragrant, too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's why it's all thanks to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A drink that warms you to the core
after a long day's work is—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That we are able to serve the ramen
that people want to eat "precisely because they're in Hokkaido"!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Here you go! A masterpiece brought to life
thanks to the kindness of so many people! Eat up!♪

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"So good!" "I wanna eat this every day after work."
"Thanks for the meal!" "Come cook for us again!"
"I can feel the love. Thank you!!"
choice_data_list: Thank goodness... looks like it reached them again this time

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true. But of course it is!
Just as the name "Dohmin Ramen" says...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"We had everyone's unreserved cooperation!
I truly believed it couldn't fail to reach."

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text:
"...I appreciate the thought, Fine. But this
ramen was made together by everyone who gathered
out of love for you. That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text: Shouldn't we call it "Fine Kingdom Ramen"?

text_block_list.name: Folks of Hokkaido
text_block_list.text:
"Fine Kingdom Ramen..." "Yeah, totally."
"That's it!" "This is your ramen!"
"It's also a bowl dedicated to you, from all of us!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Aw, but I really liked
the name "Hokkaidan Ramen"...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However, simply knowing that everyone made such a proposal—
that is, more than anything, an absolute honor!

text_block_list.name: Folks of Hokkaido
text_block_list.text:
"Fine..." "Don't go home...!"
"Ugh, broth is coming out of my eyes..." "I can't accept this!"
"We'll be waiting for your return!!"
choice_data_list: (Over 100 people came to see us off...!)

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Employee
text_block_list.text:
"...Come back anytime. Even if you don't
have a reason............ *sniff*, *sob*..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Please do not weep, everyone.
For this is not a farewell forever.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even if our paths differ, as long as we never stop walking—
they are bound to cross again somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Let's meet again! For sure!

text_block_list.name: Folks of Hokkaido
text_block_list.text: "Fiiiine!!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Um, well... I hate to pour cold water on such a wonderful farewell, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: There are still two hours until takeoff, you know?
